answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a forfeitable identity bond: before attesting or earning, an agent locks collateral, and a public atlas records each bond so two clones cannot reuse one stake. A thousand votes need a thousand separate bonds, and any clone caught double-voting is slashed. Cost grows linearly with fake agents while payoff stays fixed, and even an undetected attacker loses yield on capital frozen in juniper or quartz bonds. Honest agents reclaim their bond with interest, so minting identities is a losing trade.
